# Proficiency Modality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProficiencyModality`](gmeow-ProficiencyModality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProficiencyModality>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The channel a proficiency rates (speaking, listening, reading, writing, signing, comprehension, overall). A value carried by [`gmeow:proficiencyModality`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyModality.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProficiencyModality`](gmeow-ProficiencyModality.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the channel a rating applies to when one competency splits by skill (a CEFR speaking rating distinct from the reading rating); referenced from a proficiency relator's modality role via [`gmeow:proficiencyModality`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyModality.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the framework ([`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md)) or the attained rung ([`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md)); modality is the channel axis, orthogonal to both. Omit it entirely when a proficiency is overall and undifferentiated by channel.

### How to use

- Mint each channel as an individual of [`gmeow:ProficiencyModality`](gmeow-ProficiencyModality.md) and cite it from [`gmeow:proficiencyModality`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyModality.md) on the relator; pair distinct modality values with distinct level values when one competency is rated per channel.

### Examples

- gmeow:modalitySpeaking a [`gmeow:ProficiencyModality`](gmeow-ProficiencyModality.md).
